topic: Various locking devices, Fasteners and fork joints
syllabus_extract: Various locking devices, Fasteners and fork joints
specific_objectives: 9.1.2.1 Trainee will be able to explain the locking and swaging etc.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Identification of locking devices on fasteners and assembly of fork joints; Safety: Wear eye protection and gloves; Instructor supervision: Monitor tool handling and torque application.
intro_questions: What is the primary function of a locking device?
Name two common types of aircraft fasteners.
Why is vibration resistance critical in engine health monitoring?

development.content:
Types of locking devices
Mechanism of locking washers
Locking nuts and prevailing torque
Safety wire installation
Swaging basics

Fork joint construction
Pin and clevis assembly
Locking methods for pins
Inspection criteria
Common failure modes

Selection of locking devices
Installation procedures
Torque specifications
Documentation requirements
Maintenance checks

summary_questions: Explain how a safety wire prevents fastener loosening.
Describe the difference between a split lock washer and a tooth lock washer.
What are the key inspection points for a fork joint assembly?
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief note on the tools required for the swaging process discussed in the next lesson plan (LP 07) and list three safety precautions specific to that procedure.
